manual_source: 993 Repair Manual (Porsche AG, 2001 printing), OCR pass 2026-08-28
rule: The manual describes the stock 993 engine. The scanned part is an aftermarket 935-type head, so no manual value calibrates it. The comparison shows only whether the scan's assumed scale (1 unit = 1 mm) is contradicted by sizes the two heads are likely to share. Manual values are OCR transcriptions and carry the status given in the manual record.
verdict: not contradicted: the two seat diameters fall on the manual's two valve heads within about 1.5%, one seat angle matches, and the forum figures for a 3.2-type head (ports of 41.5 and 40 mm, a 49 mm inlet valve, guides of about 13 mm) fall inside what the scan shows. This supports the scale as an indication and the inlet role of valve_y_minus. It is not a calibration and it identifies no dimension of the specimen.

comparisons.scan: seat cone of valve_y_minus, diameter at mid-band about the guide axis
comparisons.reading: the seat contact circle is a little smaller than the valve head; the two agree within 0.1%

comparisons.manual: 42.5 + 0.1 mm (43.5 + 0.1 mm on a second variant)
comparisons.scan: seat cone of valve_y_plus, diameter at mid-band about the valve axis
half-angle of the two seat cones about their own axes
comparisons.reading: valve_y_minus within 0.5 degree; valve_y_plus, detected only, 4 degrees off

comparisons.scan: guide bore of valve_y_minus, one cylinder over 48.8 mm
comparisons.reading: the scan reads 0.5 mm larger; either this head takes another guide or the scanner misreads a small deep bore (CloudCompare did not confirm this fit)
too small for an M14 thread; consistent with a 12 mm plug, so this head differs from the stock 993 head here

comparisons.scan: register recess 113.36 mm, chamber shoulder 92.80 mm
comparisons.reading: no scanned feature is the bore itself; no comparison is drawn

ddk_forum.dataset: PorscheFanatics data/forum-measurements.json, 5,916 records read from the public boards of the DDK forum (ddk-online.com) on 2026-10-27
ddk_forum.dataset_terms: the forum's robots.txt content signal: search=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference
ddk_forum.rule: Forum figures: reported, quoted or measured by members on early 911, 3.2 Carrera and RSR-type engines, none on this head. Only record identifiers, values and the stated basis are given here; no post text and no member field. They are leads, weaker than the manual, and calibrate nothing.
searched_and_not_found: any cylinder head temperature (the 45 temperature records are oil, heater-duct, thermostat and fitting temperatures)
any cooling-air delivery of the engine fan (the 12 flow records are fuel flows)
